definitions: The runtime context in which JavaScript code is executed, including the JavaScript engine, global objects, and any host-provided objects or APIs.
A specific setup or platform (e.g., browser, Node.js, Deno) that provides the necessary components for running JavaScript applications.
examples: A browser is a common JS environment.
Node.js provides a server-side JS environment.
Understanding the JS environment is crucial for debugging.
Different JS environments have varying APIs.
